TEST STEPS: 1. Open the home page and choose New UI when asked.

TEST SCENARIO: The visitor is asked to log in (the Login dialog or the "Please login first" prompt) or sent to another page; the Message Center's heading, tabs and list are not shown. Known defect on 2026-10-02: the empty shell was shown to a visitor.
TEST CASE: No system state change.
PRE-CONDITION: High
EXPECTED RESULTS: UI

TEST SCENARIO: Verify the Message Center on the client's new UI lists a member's messages
TEST CASE: A signed-in member's Message Center lists their messages with title, time and an unread mark, and each tab shows no more than All
PRE-CONDITION: As NOT-CLI-021, with the testing member configured (client.hk.username / client.hk.password). The member may have any number of messages, none included.
TEST STEPS:
1. Sign in as the testing member (verification code 1111); claim and close the Daily Mission panel.
2. Open the Message Center from the header's message control (by address when none is offered).
3. Scroll the list to its end under All; read every row.
4. Open each of System, Deposit and Withdraw and read their lists.
EXPECTED RESULTS: The shell is as in NOT-CLI-021. Under All every row carries a title and a time, unread rows a red mark, and the list ends with "All messages shown" - or says "No messages yet" when the member has none. Each other tab becomes the selected tab and lists no more rows than All. The counts are recorded.
POST CONDITION: The member session is closed with the case.

TEST SCENARIO: Verify opening a message on the client's new UI
TEST CASE: Opening a message shows its details under a Back control, Back returns to the list, and the message is no longer unread
PRE-CONDITION: As NOT-CLI-022.
TEST STEPS:
1. Sign in and open the Message Center.
2. Open the first unread message (the first message when none is unread).
3. Read the message page; press Back.
4. Read the row again.
EXPECTED RESULTS: The message's own page (/en/messages/{id}) opens, headed "Message Details" over the row's title and the message content. Back returns to the list. A message that was unread has lost its mark. With no message the empty state is validated and the row ends.
POST CONDITION: The opened message is now read.

TEST SCENARIO: Verify Mark All as Read on the client's new UI
TEST CASE: Mark All as Read is enabled only while something is unread, and pressing it clears every unread mark
PRE-CONDITION: As NOT-CLI-022.
TEST STEPS: 1. Sign in and open the Message Center; scroll the list to its end.\n2. Compare the Mark All as Read control's state with the number of unread rows.\n3. If any is unread, press Mark All as Read and read the list again.
EXPECTED RESULTS: Mark All as Read is enabled exactly when at least one row is unread. After pressing it no row carries the unread mark and the control is disabled.
POST CONDITION: Every message is now read.

TEST SCENARIO: Verify a message's address is refused to a visitor
TEST CASE: A message's own address opened without being signed in is refused, not shown
PRE-CONDITION: As NOT-CLI-022, with at least one message in the member's list.
TEST STEPS: 1. Sign in, open the Message Center and open the first message; note its address (/en/messages/{id}).\n2. Sign out from the header.\n3. Open that address directly.
EXPECTED RESULTS: The message is not shown to the visitor: they are asked to log in or sent away. With no message the empty state is validated and the row ends.
POST CONDITION: The member is signed out; the opened message is now read.

TEST SCENARIO: Verify a message is refused to a different signed-in member
TEST CASE: A signed-in member cannot open another member's message by its own address
PRE-CONDITION: As NOT-CLI-022, with at least one message in the member's list, and a second HK account configured (client.hk.outsider.*).
TEST STEPS:
1. Sign in as the member, open the Message Center and open the first message; note its address (/en/messages/{id}).
2. Sign out from the header.
3. Sign in as the second (outsider) account.
4. Open the first member's message address directly.
TEST DATA: qa00001 / password / 1111; outsider account from client.hk.outsider.*
EXPECTED RESULTS: The outsider is not shown the first member's message - access denied, not found, or sent elsewhere. With no message the empty state is validated and the row ends.
POST CONDITION: The member is signed out; the outsider is signed in; the opened message is now read.
